_comment: Static values both clients must agree on, in one place — see tokens/build-shared.mjs for how this becomes android-app's GeneratedSharedConfig.kt and web-app/shared-config.js (run `npm run build:shared` after editing; both outputs are committed). Deliberately data, not code: nothing in call-core decides anything from these, so they live here instead of in the Rust crate (changing a relay shouldn't need a wasm rebuild). Decision logic both clients share lives in call-core.
